response.overview: Twenty-seven-year-old Mina keeps a jellyfish in a tank in the middle of her studio apartment. She works part-time at an art supply shop, always pushing job hunting off to "later." Mina holds one strange belief: "We can only be clean once the jellyfish is dealt with." For the past month, she's been planning the jellyfish's disposal — quietly gathering supplies from the shop, piece by piece. Today, the final package finally arrives. Safety goggles on, rubber gloves on, she prepares for the task with something like reverence. And once again, she feeds the jellyfish instead. She meant to do it. She didn't. Guess there's always tomorrow.
response.title: How to Treat a Jellyfish
